content:
Lean folks,

I made this bot(with AI help, full disclosure). Since Mathlib (or another library) which changes a lot and lots of downstream projects use it.

  • This tool tries to automatically fix the issues using compiler warnings and suggestions.
  • Important no AI is used to fix broken code, only compiler/toolchain suggestions like 'try this....' or output from 'simp?/exact?'
  • Creates a PR to be reviewed.

Repo -> https://github.com/FawadHa1der/lean-churn-bot/

  • Real-world sample: I ran it on ⟨FLT at commit b80f22719410f979c475e9b1d62221ec1dd7a3c6 to 910a7566b3f8a515bfc5417cdd31b2ed1ce4df93, bumping mathlib: ⟨41⟩ automatic fixes, ⟨56⟩ left for humans, transcript and PR here:
    https://github.com/FawadHa1der/FLT/pull/1

Let me know what you y'all think, if it's useful or not. May be there is already an existing tool which does this, which I didn't know about. Feedback welcome

Community moderators please let me know if you find an issue with this announcement and I will address it. It's not obvious to me who to contact or ask beforehand about this announcement.
